input.question: Is the fence that was destroyed entirely on your side of the property line, or is it a shared fence that belongs equally to both you and your neighbor?

input.rationale: Storm-caused damage to the policyholder's own garage roof, parked vehicle (auto comprehensive), and fence is straightforward property damage; auto damage is covered under auto comprehensive, but the primary structure/roof loss drives classification to property_damage queue.

Multiple damage locations (garage roof, parked car, fence), emergency services on-site, and polyholder unable to fully assess damage yet all indicate this claim likely exceeds $25k; adjuster needs on-site inspection urgently.

input.claim_summary: Storm damage claim for POL-1008 (Avery Santos). Major overnight storm caused damage to garage roof, parked vehicle, and shared fence; possible debris was either falling tree or part of neighbor's shed. Emergency services present on-scene. Policyholder unable to fully assess due to ongoing emergency response. Adjuster on-site inspection urgently needed to determine source of damage and third-party liability implications.
